headlines.title: Can MCD's Slower Expansion Pace Help Protect New-Restaurant Returns?
headlines.summary: McDonald's slower expansion pace seeks to protect new-restaurant returns as higher development costs and consumer pressure reshape its growth timeline.

headlines.title: Why Franchise Models Are Winning the Restaurant Stock Divide
headlines.summary: QSR and Yum! Brands posted strong Q2 2026 results on franchise economics and global diversification, while McDonald's U.S. sales slowed on execution missteps despite similar franchise strength.

headlines.title: McDonald's (MCD) Exit From A 90% Restaurant Stake Still Haunts Investors
headlines.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) previously owned about 90% of Chipotle before exiting the investment in 2006. The company sold its stake as part of a refocus on its core fast food operations, leaving Chipotle to list and expand independently. A recent look back highlights how much long-term market value McDonald's did not capture by selling its Chipotle holding. Investors are using this episode to compare McDonald's approach with Chipotle's different growth and brand strategies over time.

headlines.title: McDonald’s India Drama Erupts While Wall Street Targets 24% Stock Rally
headlines.summary: McDonald's India's X account melted into memecoin posts while Wall Street still targets a 24% MCD stock rally.

headlines.title: McDonald's Once Owned 90% Of A Popular Restaurant Chain. Selling It Left Billions On The Table
headlines.summary: McDonald's may have spent the better part of a century dominating the fast food industry, but the company has made the occasional costly error.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
